selection_method: Latest runs directory that contains clusters.json, by directory name. Window is that file's actual_start through actual_end. Candidates are theme review_ids that are also in data/exports/play_store.csv with review_date inside the window, using text_clean. Themes are ordered by theme_id. Review ids inside a theme are sorted. Selection round-robins one row per theme. Empty text and text that still matches a PII pattern after redaction are skipped and not stored. If theme members run out before 20, the rest are the remaining in-window CSV rows in review_id order, with the same redaction rule. Stored text is the redacted text only.
